versions.content: If the return ed value is ‘ DEM_NO_SUCH_ELEMENT ’ the J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall call PduR_J1939DcmTransmit with the PduId of the requested message and set the destination address (via MetaData) according to the source address of the request, or to 0xFF when the destination of the request was 0xFF.

If the return ed value is ‘ DEM_NO_SUCH_ELEMENT ’ the J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall call PduR_J1939DcmTransmit with the PduId of the requested message and set the destination address (via MetaData) according to the source address of the request, or to 0xFF when the destination of the request was 0xFF.
